stemMd: A material costs 18 units per kilogram. What is the cost of 750 grams?
explanationMd: Convert 750 grams to 0.75 kg. Multiply by 18 units per kg to obtain 13.5 units. The amount is below one kilogram, so the cost should be below 18.

distractorRationale.b: This introduces a factor of ten.
distractorRationale.c: This charges for a full kilogram.
distractorRationale.e: This divides by 0.75 instead of multiplying.
